summary: Session 1 of 5 (Contract And QBE Helper Foundation). Three decisions locked: (1) GridQueryRequest transport DTO added to AcmeCoffeeOnline.Shared.DTOs with supporting types (GridQuerySort, GridQueryFilter, GridCompositeFilter, GridFilterLogic) — one unified DTO from UI to service layer; (2) POST /api/{entity}s/query [FromBody] for HTTP transport (nested filter graph cannot serialize to URL); (3) QueryableExtensions.ApplyGridCompositeFilter + ApplyGridQuerySorts added to AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Infrastructure as the server-side QBE→LINQ helper. Decision documents authored: request-contract-decision.md, qbe-helper-api.md. 13 unit tests added and passing. Cross-provider verification (GPT-5.4) took 3 rounds — Rounds 1-2 found real correctness bugs (JsonElement deserialization of object? Value, nullable value-type constant expression). Both fixed with tests. Round 3 VERIFIED.
